mapper.sql: SELECT part_id, part_code, part_name, part_type, spec_model, unit, applicable_category, supplier, stock_min, stock_max, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM dms_spare_part
mapper.delete: UPDATE dms_spare_part SET del_flag = '2' WHERE part_id IN #{partId}
mapper.select: SELECT part_code FROM dms_spare_part WHERE part_code LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') ORDER BY part_code DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT p.part_id, p.part_code, p.part_name, p.part_type, p.spec_model, p.unit, p.supplier, p.status, p.del_flag, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.stock_min > 0 AND s.current_stock <= p.stock_min THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as alert_low_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.stock_max > 0 AND s.current_stock >= p.stock_max THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as alert_over_count, COALESCE(SUM(s.current_stock), 0) as current_stock FROM dms_spare_part p LEFT JOIN dms_spare_part_stock s ON p.part_id = s.part_id AND s.del_flag = '0' WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.status = '0' AND p.part_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{partCode}, '%') AND p.part_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{partName}, '%') AND p.part_type = #{partType} GROUP BY p.part_id, p.part_code, p.part_name, p.part_type, p.spec_model, p.unit, p.supplier, p.status, p.del_flag HAVING alert_low_count > 0 OR alert_over_count > 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN alert_low_count > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, current_stock ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_spare_part SET stock_min = NULL, stock_max = NULL WHERE part_id = #{partId}
